plugins.name: wechat-devtools
plugins.description: Drive the local WeChat DevTools CLI: open/close projects, preview QR codes, upload versions, build npm, deploy cloud functions, and run automation.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 驱动本机微信开发者工具 CLI：打开/关闭项目、生成预览二维码、上传版本、构建 npm、部署云函数、跑自动化。

plugins.name: alipay-mini
plugins.description: Drive the Alipay mini program CLI (minidev): build without the IDE, run the dev server, preview on device, upload, submit for review, and manage versions.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 驱动支付宝小程序 CLI（minidev）：无需 IDE 编译、开发服务器、真机预览、上传、提审与版本管理。

plugins.name: aliyun-devops
plugins.description: Use the Yunxiao (云效) CLI — aliyun devops — for Codeup repositories, Flow pipelines and deployments, Projex work items and effort hours, AppStack applications, artifact packages, and Testhub.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用云效 CLI（aliyun devops）管理 Codeup 代码库、Flow 流水线与部署、Projex 工作项与工时、AppStack 应用交付、制品仓库和测试。

plugins.name: wiztree
plugins.description: Drive WizTree disk space analysis: scan drives and folders, export CSV and treemap PNG, locate large files and duplicates, and plan safe cleanup.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 驱动 WizTree 磁盘分析：扫描磁盘与目录、导出 CSV 与树图 PNG、定位大文件与重复文件、制定安全清理方案。
